question: Who secured India’s latest Olympic medal in freestyle wrestling at Paris 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aman Sehrawat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Aman Sehrawat** secured India’s latest Olympic medal in freestyle wrestling at the Paris 2024 Olympics, continuing the nation’s strong tradition in the sport.
 
• He competed in the **57 kg freestyle wrestling category**, showcasing exceptional skill and determination throughout the tournament.
 
• Aman Sehrawat is known for his rapid rise in the international wrestling circuit, having previously won medals at prestigious tournaments like the **Asian Wrestling Championships** and **Junior World Championships**.
 
• His victory at Paris 2024 solidified India’s reputation as a powerhouse in wrestling on the global stage.
 
• He is mentored by some of India’s top wrestling coaches and trains at world-class facilities to enhance his skills and performance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bajrang Punia**

 
 
• Bajrang Punia is one of India’s most celebrated wrestlers, specializing in the **65 kg freestyle wrestling category**.
 
• He won a **bronze medal at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics** and is a multiple-time World Wrestling Championships medalist.
 
• Bajrang is known for his aggressive style and technical acumen on the mat.
 
• Though a strong contender, he did not secure a medal at the Paris 2024 Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Ravi Kumar Dahiya**
 
 
• Ravi Kumar Dahiya gained fame for winning a **silver medal in the 57 kg freestyle category** at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
 
• He is a two-time Asian Champion and a consistent performer at the international level.
 
• Despite being one of India’s top wrestlers, he did not win a medal at the Paris 2024 Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Sakshi Malik**
 
 
• Sakshi Malik made history by becoming the **first Indian woman wrestler to win an Olympic medal** with her bronze in the 58 kg category at the Rio 2016 Olympics.
 
• She has since been a prominent figure in Indian wrestling, inspiring many young athletes.
 
• Sakshi did not participate in the medal-winning events for India at the Paris 2024 Olympics.
 
 
 
• **India’s Wrestling Success**
 
 
• Wrestling has been one of India’s most successful sports at the Olympics, with several medals won across different editions of the Games.
 
• Indian wrestlers have consistently performed well in categories like freestyle and Greco-Roman wrestling, bringing laurels to the country.
 
• Focused training programs, world-class coaching, and government support have significantly contributed to the success of Indian wrestlers on the global stage.
